cards.title: Why it works
items: A single classifier node, complementary `when` predicates on the arm heads: the branch is grammar, not agent discretion
Empty queue is a RESULT — the notice arm ends the run quietly instead of a failed fan-out waking anyone
Routine work rides the batch fan-out; only urgent items spend a human escalation gate

cards.title: Contract
items: {{agents}} agents, {{gates}} gates, {{fanouts}} fan-out: intake -> classify -> when-guarded arms split to batch|urgent|empty
escalate is a human gate mid-arm; report joins every arm, live or pruned, from ## Inputs payloads
